verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Asana has native 'rule actions', app components that plug into 'rules', and an AI Studio for 'no-code automations', indicating a trigger-and-action automation builder exists. However, the pack lacks direct documentation of the rules builder UI/experience itself (trigger types, conditions, action library) and has no independent/community corroboration of engineers actually using it to eliminate manual steps. Missing for 10: detailed native Rules builder documentation, list of supported triggers/actions, and hands-on/community evidence of engineers building and relying on these automations.
